subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add opt-in all-Space-message ingestion, and should that use Workspace Events/Pub/Sub with user OAuth or app authorization rather than the current service-account HTTP webhook model?
rationale: The remaining request changes which Space messages can reach OpenClaw, which credentials and OAuth scopes are stored, and how subscriptions are provisioned, so automation should not choose the privacy/security boundary.

options.title: Design Opt-In Workspace Events Mode
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a design covering OAuth scopes, subscription lifecycle, consent, allowlists, docs, tests, and live Google Chat proof before implementation.

options.title: Defer All-Message Ingestion
options.body: Document Google Chat as @mention/webhook-only for now and close or narrow the issue only after maintainers explicitly reject the broader visibility surface.

options.title: Split Threading From Ingestion
options.body: Let focused thread/session fixes proceed separately while tracking all-message ingestion in a dedicated product/security design item.

recommendation.title: Design Opt-In Workspace Events Mode
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a design covering OAuth scopes, subscription lifecycle, consent, allowlists, docs, tests, and live Google Chat proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current routing signal from Google Chat API/thread history and recent security-sensitive plugin boundary work.
